lines:
Follow-up from task 143 (number 142). Commit 3173c99 derives the retained tail from the window's target: budget = 0.25 W - fixed, summary = 38.2% of the budget capped at 8,000, tail = the rest. The "Retained history budget" field in desktop/src/workbench/settings-v2/CompactionSettings.tsx therefore no longer controls a windowed Chat:

- retainRatio (default 0.16) is now inert for every Chat. With a declared window the tail comes from the target; without a declared window the runtime calls retention(window.unwrap_or_default()) with window 0, so the ratio multiplies a zero. Nothing in the token path reads the number a user types.
- retainTokens (absolute) is still honoured, but only for a Chat with no declared window, where it sets the tail for the legacy 512 KiB byte-pressure path.

Measured: a Chat with contextWindow 100,000 and fixed 12,400 retains 7,787 tokens no matter what the field says, while the field's help text still promises "Minimum recent history to preserve verbatim; must be below the trigger".

Options: (a) relabel the field so it clearly applies only when the model declares no context window, and show the derived tail (window, target, summary cap) as read-only evidence in the same panel; (b) honour an explicitly set absolute retainTokens as a floor on the derived tail, spending the tail first and the summary only from what remains - this reintroduces an over-budget plan and a second meaning for "target", so it needs its own arithmetic and its own tests; (c) remove the field. Recommend (a): it is honest about the derived model, needs no policy change, and keeps a real knob for the no-window case.

Acceptance: the setting panel does not promise behaviour the policy no longer implements; whatever remains configurable is honoured by policy and covered by a test; the desktop bundle is rebuilt and the running app verified after the change.

Also in scope here, discovered in the same review: docs/context-compaction.md still documents the R/2 derivation, the U = R/2 carried-user budget and the 64k floor from c848df3. Bring it in line with the target-0.25 model of 3173c99 (budget = 0.25 W - fixed, summary share 0.382 capped at 8,000, minimum_replacement = 2,512, minimum_window(fixed) = ceil((fixed + 2,512)/0.25)) and record the derived-floor numbers for fixed 12,400/12,300.

data.title: The "Retained history budget" setting no longer controls a windowed tail, and docs still describe the R/U/S model
